FROM dim_store
WHERE store_name ILIKE '%Pitäjänmäki%' OR city ILIKE '%Helsinki%'
ORDER BY store_name
LIMIT 20

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE s.store_id = 102
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-08-31' AND '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 3

calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, calendar_year, calendar_month
FROM dim_date
WHERE calendar_date = '2026-10-07'

SELECT MIN(calendar_date) AS earliest_date, MAX(calendar_date) AS latest_date
FROM dim_date

SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year
FROM dim_date
WHERE calendar_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-10-04'
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT 
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE s.store_id = 102
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-08-31' AND '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 10
